rules.title: A contract claim names what pins it
rules.text: A `verified`, `measured` or `pinned by` claim in the frozen contract names the harness, command or measurement that pins it: a claim the reader cannot re-run is indistinguishable from one nobody checked.

judgement.question: Does this sentence name the harness, command, log or measurement that pins the claim, or does the reader have to trust it?

criteria.true: the claim is asserted without naming how it was checked
criteria.false: the sentence names the harness, command, path or measurement, or it is not a claim about a result
